## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks actually performed and their results. Distinguish preflight, simulation and real app/hardware testing. For active brightness tests, include whether original values were restored.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe affected macOS/display cases, permission or lifecycle changes, and anything not yet verified. State whether this changes the launcher/Lua packaging, the prebuilt engine input or a full native engine build.

## References

Link the related public issue or documentation, if any. Keep private preferences, display identifiers, receipts, personal logs and credentials out of the pull request.
